corrected_value.title: The cocktail party phenomenon revisited: Attention and memory in the classic selective listening procedure of Cherry (1953).

decisions.reason: No prior adjudication or state file exists for this work. The primary text explicitly retests Wood and Cowan (1995), which first introduced the online shadowing-error analysis across word positions around the presentation of one's own name (positions -1, 0, +1, +2, and +3) alongside retrospective name detection (35% vs. 29% here). Shipped row 144 (Moray, 1959, 10.1080/17470215908416289) is a distinct earlier study that measured only retrospective name detection and did not examine shadowing errors by word position; report equivalence does not apply.
